sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed every two years as 
indicated by Y2 in the title block.

Each Mazout fuel oil tank is equipped with a
suction heater, which is a flooded type open to storage tank it's
used to heat Mazout in the low temperature conditions and maintain the Mazout oil
viscosity required for the proper operation, the medium of the Mazout is the
auxiliary steam

Each 
Mazout daily tank is provided with a fuel oil
heater to maintain the Mazout oil viscosity required for the proper operation
of the burner fuel oil P/Ps the fuel oil heater uses the steam as a heating
medium

Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the control circuit breaker for
heat exch.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out

Inspect 
for corrosion especially around connections and under inspection clean the 
corroded parts or repair and plug any leaked tubes or repaint.

Check 
inlet and outlet temperature, so clean the inner faces of the tubes from dirties 
or strange parts.

Check 
abnormal noise, so repair the defected tubes or control the steam flow.

Check 
steam flow rate from the auxiliary steam system at 1.17 kg/s

Check 
steam trap conditions and change any defected parts from the internal parts of 
the trap.

Retightened cover bolts if there is
leakage.
